description: RSB: A Decision and Design Framework for Multi-Hazard Resilient and Sustainable Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Mehrdad Sasani, Northeastern University (northeastern.edu). This project presents a decision framework for multiobjective optimization (MOO) of resilient and sustainable building design considering multiple hazards. To regenerate the results presented in published papers and to carry out multiobjective optimization of resilient and sustainable building design. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-5kyy-3a11. Keywords: Design Framework; Resilience; Sustainability; Buildings; Envelope; Decision Making; Multiobjective Optimization Structure; Natural Hazards; Earthquake; Flood; Wind; Fragility Function; Joint Probability; Window; Energy. Published 2022-02-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
